answer: Under interaction-deposit auditing, new agents stake 5% of first-month earnings. Each epoch a beacon lottery audits 10% of agents, who must show three receipts counter-signed by random past work partners, never accounts sharing their funding source. Vouching builds a bridge between strangers who cannot coordinate. Like shale layers, audits stack epoch by epoch, exposing fakes. Attackers pay: each fake faces a 10% audit chance per epoch; one failure burns the 5% deposit and suspends the identity for 30 epochs. A reef of fakes burns deposits faster than stolen fees return.
